server.name: Trade It
server.title: Trade It
server.description: Connect an agent to the user's brokerage accounts across Charles Schwab, Coinbase, ETrade, Kraken, Moomoo, Public, Robinhood, Tastytrade, TradeStation, TradeStation Paper, Webull: read accounts, holdings, and trade history, look up assets, draft stock, crypto, and options orders for review, execute or cancel orders, and create shareable trade links.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Use Trade It when the user needs brokerage account access, market asset lookup, draft order review, cancellation, or explicitly approved live trade execution across Charles Schwab, Coinbase, ETrade, Kraken, Moomoo, Public, Robinhood, Tastytrade, TradeStation, TradeStation Paper, Webull. Favor read operations first, create draft trades before execution, only execute a live trade after the user has clearly confirmed the exact order, and only cancel an order when the user clearly requests it.

tool.name: create_options_trade
tool.title: Create Options Trade
tool.description:
Create a draft options trade order with one or more concrete legs.
Use for single options, vertical spreads, and mixed equity/option strategies.
Option legs require OCC symbols. Equity legs use occ: null.
This tool returns a draft order only; brokerage execution is a separate tool.

occ.description: Option contract in OCC format without the root symbol: YYMMDD, C or P, then the strike x1000 zero-padded to 8 digits, e.g. "240119C00195000" for the Jan 19, 2024 $195 call. Use null for equity legs.

type.description: Whether the leg trades an option contract or shares of the underlying.

action.description: Whether the leg buys or sells.

quantity.description: Number of contracts for options or shares for equity

position_effect.description: Whether an option leg opens a new position or closes an existing one. Use null for equity legs.

legs.description: Array of trade legs. At least one leg is required.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the underlying asset, e.g. SPX or TSLA

direction.description: Net cash flow of a multi-leg spread: debit when paying, credit when receiving, even for zero-net. Set for multi-leg spreads only.

account_id.description: ID of the brokerage account to trade in, from get_accounts. Omit to use the user's default account.

order_type.description: How the order is priced. Omit for a market order.

stop_price.description: Price per share, in the asset currency, that triggers the order. Set for stop and stop_limit orders.

limit_price.description: Net price per spread unit for limit and stop_limit orders, in the asset currency. Use 0 with direction even for a zero-net spread.

time_in_force.description: How long the order stays open: day expires at market close, gtc stays open until canceled. Omit to use the brokerage default.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trade It to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trade It to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tradeit.app/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Trade It MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Trade It scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Trade It's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Trade It scores 84/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 10 of 10 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trade It?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Trade It in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
